sefariaRef: Ohr Penimi on Talmud Eser HaSefirot 14:12

items.sefariaRef: Ohr Penimi on Talmud Eser HaSefirot 14:12:1
items.html: A spirit comprising only his six extremities, and therefore he cannot give birth: For before the first union, he has only the VAK of Ruach, which is then in the discernment of GE and lacks AHP; and through the second Ibur he acquires AHP, and his vessels are completed to ten Sefirot, and he acquires the discernment of GAR of Ruach, as is known. And so it is with his Nukva, who, before the second Ibur, is in the discernment of back to back with ZA, and has only VAK of Ruach; and through the coupling of the night at midnight, which is then the discernment of the first union, she attains GAR of Ruach, called the Rucha that the husband leaves in her in the first union, and then she is fit to raise MAN for the purpose of giving birth, in the coupling of the day, in Sim Shalom, as is known.
